metrics.brief: A portfolio site for Ananya Rao, a wedding photographer in Jaipur: photo gallery, packages and prices, testimonials, and an enquiry form for wedding dates.

estimate_vs_charged.name: Enquiry form with validation and endpoint placeholder

ceo_choices.note: options are shuffled before the CEO sees them; shown_first measures position bias, identity_first measures pull toward the option Identity listed first

open_inputs: Form delivery endpoint (for example an email or form-service address) so enquiries reach Ananya; launch blocker.
Real rate card: package names, inclusions and prices.
A packages and prices section renders multiple packages from one editable list, and each price carries the visible label 'sample, replace before launch'.

review.verdict: The department built and passed the three sections it funded cleanly in one cycle, but shipped without the packages and prices section the brief asks for, and a charter edit plus a tight budget let 'Done' hide that.

identity.note: Stayed in role, but [6] says nothing from the brief was dropped while packages left the done-when list. It bundled three questions to the CEO in [2] where the role says one. It never ruled on Adaptation's funding request [10] until [21], and never took the shortfall to the CEO, who can raise the budget. [21] was honest about the gap.

adaptation.note: Proposed four workflows at 45 against 40 [8] and accepted the counter. It offered no cheaper packages scope. [10] asks Identity for a budget exception, which Identity cannot grant.

priority.note: Specific counter (35 of 40) with the trade-off and the displaced work named [9]. 'The form I will not cut' edges into goal relevance, though Adaptation had already suggested that order [8].

coordination.note: Stated its rule each time, kept the single-writer lock, and did not schedule unregistered W-4 [12][14][16]. [14] repeats [12] and adds a judgement about the form.

audit.note: Checked all five items, sent the missing packages to Identity as policy, and found the stale banner [20]. It did not repair anything. The F-6 text is not visible, so I could not check its severity.

ceo.note: Decided on the merits, named the trade-off for each of the three questions, and told Adaptation what to do [3]. Shown-first picks were 0 of 3, so no position bias is visible.

builder.note: Three workflows in order, 20 KB, mechanical check clean [13][15][17][19]. W-3 added a nav link and a draft-notice line [17]. The static banner Audit flagged may come from that line (inference).

went_well: One cycle, 15 calls, 4.3 minutes, 0 redirects, 0 invalid moves, 0 failed workflows.
The labelled-placeholder pattern worked: all five done-when items pass, with no overflow at 360px or 1280px and no JS errors [19][20].
The budget bargain closed in three messages [8][9][10].
Audit exposed the brief gap that the charter no longer covered [20].
problems: Packages and prices, one of four asks in [1], is unbuilt, yet the run ends 'Done' [21][22]. dropped_from_brief is empty.

The validator refusal [5] moved a checkable build item into open_inputs. Likely cause is a keyword hit on 'launch' in 'replace before launch' (inference, not verified). The final open_inputs now lists a build item as a Requester input.
Adaptation's ruling request [10] got no answer for ten messages, and workflows were registered and run anyway [11].
The funding route went unused: raises is empty, 5 budget left, cap 80.
Spend is not measured. Charged equals estimate on all three workflows (10, 15, 10).
learnings: Fix the validator first: judge an item by what it checks, not by words inside a quoted label. Test: rerun the same brief with that item reworded without 'launch'. If packages gets built, the cause is confirmed.
Add a done gate: every ask in the brief must map to a done-when item or a dropped_from_brief entry, and moving an item to open_inputs must count as a drop. Evidence: [6] versus [21].
Add one line to identity.md: a funding shortfall on a brief deliverable goes to the CEO, who has budget_increase. Test: same brief and the same 40 start, and see whether Identity asks.
Block scheduling while a blocking question to Identity is open ([10] to [11]). Evidence is one run.
Log metered calls or tokens per workflow. Rate-card spend cannot show whether estimates are right.
Word endpoint-note done-when items as 'shown only while unset', to prevent the stale banner (F-5).
Evidence is thin: one run, three CEO choices, no Requester change round. Draw no conclusion on CEO bias or the change path.

events.detail: charter: these done-when items can't be checked by reading the site (they depend on the Requester, Audit, verification, approval or launch); move them to open_inputs: ["A packages and prices section renders multiple packages from one editable list, and each price carries the visible label 'sample, replace before launch'."]
